A small update to make starting NSXL feel cleaner.

**Download `NSXL-v1.1.1.apk` below.** It installs over v1.1.0 and keeps your settings.

### Fixed
- **No more wallpaper flash on start-up.** NSXL now holds a black splash with its icon until the start-up animation is ready, then hands straight over to it. The live wallpaper only starts once the page is drawn.
- **Starts in landscape** instead of briefly drawing in portrait first. Your rotation setting still applies once it's open.
- The start-up animation always uses the black background, matching the new icon.
